presets.name: Slow push-in
presets.description: The camera slowly pushes closer to the subject.

presets.name: Dolly zoom
presets.description: The camera dollies as the lens zooms to create a shifting background.

presets.name: Crash zoom
presets.description: The camera snaps into a tight zoom on the subject.

presets.name: 360 orbit
presets.description: The camera makes a full orbit around the subject.

presets.name: FPV fly-through
presets.description: The camera flies dynamically through the scene from an FPV viewpoint.

presets.name: Crane reveal
presets.description: The camera rises on a crane to reveal the scene.

presets.name: Handheld follow
presets.description: A handheld camera follows the subject with natural movement.

presets.name: Whip pan
presets.description: The camera whips quickly left with energetic motion blur.

presets.name: Bullet-time orbit
presets.description: The camera circles the nearly frozen subject in a dramatic arc.

presets.name: Overhead top-down
presets.description: A steady overhead view looks straight down on the scene.

presets.name: Rack focus
presets.description: Focus shifts from the foreground subject to the background.

presets.name: Parallax truck
presets.description: The camera trucks right to create layered parallax across the scene.

presets.name: Slow pull-out
presets.description: The camera slowly pulls away to reveal more of the surroundings.

presets.name: Tilt reveal
presets.description: The camera tilts upward from a detail to reveal the subject.

presets.name: Low-angle hero
presets.description: A low camera angle frames the subject as confident and powerful.

presets.name: Dutch drift
presets.description: A tracking camera holds a tilted Dutch angle for unease.

presets.name: Pedestal rise
presets.description: The camera rises vertically on a pedestal beside the subject.

presets.name: Pedestal drop
presets.description: The camera descends vertically to settle at subject level.

presets.name: Orbit right
presets.description: The camera arcs smoothly around the subject to the right.

presets.name: Zoom-out reveal
presets.description: The lens zooms out to reveal the wider setting.

presets.name: Over-the-shoulder
presets.description: An eye-level over-the-shoulder view connects the speaker and listener.

presets.name: POV walk
presets.description: The camera moves forward from the subject's point of view.

presets.name: Ground-level track
presets.description: A low ground-level camera tracks alongside the moving subject.

presets.name: Static close-up
presets.description: A steady 85mm close-up isolates the subject's expression.

presets.name: Wide crane down
presets.description: A wide view descends gently from above toward the scene.
